coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1: Zone 2 Low-Impact Aerobic Endurance Cycling. Your HRV of 30 ms signals that your body is not primed for high-intensity intervals today. priority_1.workout_details: 60 minutes total duration. 10 min warm-up ramping into Zone 2, 40 min steady aerobic riding at 85-95 RPM (HR strictly below 145 bpm), 10 min cool-down. Keep power smoothly distributed.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to restart CTL progression safely. Cycling minimizes orthopedic impact while stimulating aerobic base adaptations, respecting your suppressed HRV status.

priority_2.workout_details: 3 sets x 8 Barbell Back Squats (focused on torque & depth), 3 sets x 8 Overhead Press, 3 sets x 10 Heavy Sandbag Clean & Carries (70kg), 3 sets x 12 Barbell Bicep Curls, 3 sets x 60s Core Planks. Rest 2 min between sets.
priority_2.reason: Excellent alternative for low-HRV days. Builds mechanical force for cycling power and running economy while targeting upper body aesthetics without taxing the cardiovascular engine.

priority_3.intensity: Zone 2 Easy (130-148 bpm / Easy conversational pace)
priority_3.workout_details: 35 minutes total. 5 min brisk walk + dynamic warm-up, 25 min continuous easy jog strictly in Zone 2, 5 min cool-down walk. Keep HR locked below 148 bpm.
priority_3.reason: Maintains running neuromuscular efficiency and bone density. Ranked lower than cycling because ground impact forces impose higher recovery stress on a low-HRV day.
